title: LA Sports Daily Digest — 15-Minute Edition
intro: It's a pivotal Tuesday in Los Angeles sports: the Dodgers are surging toward October with five straight wins but face unsettling questions about Shohei Ohtani, USC's Jayden Maiava is redefining what a quarterback can do, and the Rams are literally taking football to the other side of the world. Buckle up — there's a lot to unpack.
intro_zh: 洛杉磯體壇今天迎來關鍵時刻：道奇隊以五連勝衝向季後賽，但 Shohei Ohtani 的前景令人心懸；USC 的 Jayden Maiava 正以驚人表現重新定義四分衛的角色；公羊隊則史無前例地將NFL帶到地球另一端。準備好，今天的體育新聞精彩可期。

segments.headline: Ohtani Confirms Pitching Season Is Over — Hitting-Only for Rest of 2026
segments.headline_zh: Ohtani 確認本季投球結束 — 2026 年剩餘時間專注打擊
segments.analysis:
Shohei Ohtani closed the book on his 2026 pitching season Monday, confirming to reporters that he will not take the mound again this year. The two-way star hasn't thrown in a game since July 3, and after a bullpen session on August 28 yielded no further progress, the Dodgers and Ohtani mutually agreed to shut him down. It's a sobering conclusion to what was supposed to be his full return to two-way dominance after the Tommy John surgery that limited him to DH duties for much of his first two seasons in Los Angeles.

The timeline is instructive. Ohtani made his long-awaited pitching return on July 3, made a handful of starts, and then hit a wall. Lower body fatigue — the same issue that plagued his late-season pitching workload — forced the Dodgers to shut him down before his body broke down entirely. It's a sign that the franchise is prioritizing October over September, even if it means leaving weapons on the shelf.

From a roster construction standpoint, this narrows the Dodgers' pitching depth significantly for the postseason. Tyler Glasnow, Yoshinobu Yamamoto, Blake Snell, and Roki Sasaki give them a formidable four-man rotation, but the loss of Ohtani as a potential swing option removes a dimension no other team can replicate. Manager Dave Roberts will now need to lean more heavily on the bullpen in October — a unit that has been inconsistent at times this year.

The bigger picture, though, is what Ohtani's bat needs to become. If he's not pitching, he has to be a fearsome presence in the lineup every single day, and right now, he isn't. His 2-for-26 skid over the last seven games is alarming for a player of his caliber. The Dodgers need vintage Ohtani at the plate — and they need it now.
segments.analysis_zh:
Shohei Ohtani 週一正式宣布本季不會再登板投球。這位二刀流球星自 7 月 3 日後就未在正式比賽中投球，8 月 28 日的牛棚練習亦無實質進展，道奇隊與 Ohtani 共同決定提前結束投球賽季。這對一位原本被寄望全面復出的球員而言，無疑是沉重的現實。

從時間線來看，Ohtani 於 7 月 3 日迎來期待已久的投球回歸，但幾場先發後即因下半身疲勞而被迫中止。道奇隊選擇在身體崩潰前主動踩煞車，這反映了球隊將季後賽置於九月賽事之上的策略思維，即便代價是放棄獨一無二的雙重武器。

就陣容結構而言，Ohtani 退出投手輪值顯著削弱了道奇隊季後賽的投球深度。Tyler Glasnow、Yoshinobu Yamamoto、Blake Snell 和 Roki Sasaki 構成強大的四人先發，但失去 Ohtani 作為潛在輪替選項，讓球隊失去其他球隊無法複製的維度。總教練 Dave Roberts 必須更依賴牛棚——而本季的牛棚表現並非始終穩定。

然而，更大的問題在於 Ohtani 的打擊表現。若不再投球，他必須每天在打線中扮演更具威脅性的角色，但近七場比賽僅 2 支安打（26 打數）的低迷表現令人擔憂。道奇隊需要的是巔峰狀態的 Ohtani——而現在正是關鍵時刻。

segments.headline: Sheehan Fans 10, Hernández Drives in 3 as Dodgers Roll Past Reds for Fifth Straight Win
segments.headline_zh: Sheehan 三振 10 人、Hernández 貢獻 3 分打點，道奇隊五連勝擊敗紅人
segments.analysis:
Emmet Sheehan delivered the kind of performance that makes front offices look prescient. Called up from Triple-A after being displaced by the Tarik Skubal acquisition, the right-hander tied a career high with 10 strikeouts across six dominant innings, scattering just three hits and one earned run. It was a masterclass in pitch sequencing, with Sheehan generating 17 whiffs — an elite number that suggests he's not just surviving at the major-league level but commanding it.

The offense did its part in unspectacular fashion. Teoscar Hernández provided the decisive blow, a three-run homer in the fifth inning that blew the game open. The Dodgers won 6-3 despite being outhit 7-3, a testament to their ability to capitalize on walks and power rather than stringing together hits. It was the second time in franchise history they scored six or more runs on just three hits — a quirky stat that underscores how efficiently this lineup produces when the long ball is working.

The bullpen held firm after Sheehan's exit. Evan Phillips recorded his first save since May 2, 2025 — a significant milestone for a reliever who's battled inconsistency and injury this season. Alex Vesia and Ben Dreyer navigated high-leverage jams in the seventh and eighth innings, and Phillips locked it down in the ninth. It's the kind of bullpen depth that wins playoff series, assuming the late-inning arms can sustain this level.

Five straight wins have pushed the Dodgers to 87-57, maintaining a commanding 10-game lead in the NL West. They're now 30 games over .500 and trending toward a first-round bye. The concern is that they were out hit 7-3 by Cincinnati — a team well under .500 — which suggests the offense isn't quite as dominant as the record implies. But in September, wins are wins, and the Dodgers are stacking them.
segments.analysis_zh:
Emmet Sheehan 用實力證明道奇隊管理層的決策是正確的。這位右投手在 Tarik Skubal 交易後被下放至 3A，如今重返大聯盟即繳出職業生涯新高的 10 次三振，六局僅被擊出 3 支安打失 1 分。他的配球策略堪稱大師級，全場製造 17 次揮空——這是精英級數據，顯示他不僅能在大聯盟生存，更能掌控比賽節奏。

打線方面則以效率取勝。Teoscar Hernández 在第五局擊出關鍵的三分全壘打，一舉拉開比數。道奇隊最終以 6-3 獲勝，儘管全場僅擊出 3 支安打而被對手擊出 7 支安打。這是道奇隊史上第二次在僅 3 安打的情況下得到 6 分以上——一項凸顯球隊長打效率的奇特數據。

牛棚在 Sheehan 退場後穩住陣腳。Evan Phillips 收下自 2025 年 5 月 2 日以來的首次救援成功——對一位本季飽受傷病與不穩定困擾的後援投手而言意義重大。Alex Vesia 和 Ben Dreyer 在七、八局高壓局面中成功化解危機，Phillips 則在九局鎖定勝利。這是能贏得季後賽系列賽的牛棚深度，前提是後援投手能維持此水準。

五連勝讓道奇隊戰績來到 87-57，國聯西區領先優勢達 10 場。球隊已超越五成勝率 30 場，朝著季後賽首輪輪空邁進。令人擔憂的是，面對战绩遠低五成的紅人隊卻僅擊出 3 支安打，顯示打線的統治力並非如战绩所呈現。但在九月，勝利就是勝利，道奇隊正持續累積。

segments.headline: Ohtani's Bat Goes Cold: 2-for-26 Slump Raises October Concerns
segments.headline_zh: Ohtani 打擊陷入冰點：26 打數僅 2 安打，十月季後賽前景堪憂
segments.analysis:
When the Dodgers announced Ohtani was done pitching, the implicit promise was that his bat would be the equalizer. Instead, he went 0-for-3 with two strikeouts and a walk Monday in his return from a four-day absence, dropping to 2-for-26 (.077) over his last seven games with zero RBIs. For a player accustomed to carrying MVP-caliber production, this is a startling cold spell — and one that demands explanation.

Manager Dave Roberts said he was pleased with how Ohtani's swing looked physically, suggesting the issue may be more mental or timing-related than mechanical. After four days off, even elite hitters can lose their rhythm at the plate. The question is whether this is a brief blip or the beginning of something more concerning. Ohtani's career history suggests he's capable of heating up at precisely the right moment — but the clock is ticking toward October.

The broader context matters here. With Ohtani no longer pitching, the Dodgers' entire offensive identity shifts. He was supposed to be the DH who occasionally took the mound, a weapon that stretched opposing pitching coaches to their limits. Now he's simply the DH, and a slumping one at that. The lineup around him — Hernández, Freddie Freeman, Will Smith — is deep enough to absorb a cold streak, but not if it lingers into the postseason.

There's also a psychological dimension. Ohtani is famously private and self-driven, but the weight of being the highest-paid player in baseball history — with the pitching side now removed from the equation — creates a different kind of pressure. The Dodgers are counting on him to be the offensive engine they signed him to be, and right now, he's running on fumes.
segments.analysis_zh:
道奇隊宣布 Ohtani 不再投球時，隱含的承諾是他的打擊火力將彌補損失。然而他週一在休息四天後重返先發名單，卻繳出 3 打數 0 安打、2 次三振和 1 次保送，近七場比賽累計僅 2 支安打（26 打數）、打點掛零。對一位慣於繳出 MVP 級表現的球員而言，這是令人震驚的低潮——且需要深入探究原因。

總教練 Dave Roberts 表示他對 Ohtani 的揮棒動作感到滿意，暗示問題可能更多是心理層面或節奏感，而非機械性的動作缺陷。休息四天後即使是精英級打者也可能失去打擊節奏。問題在於這是否只是短暫波動，還是更令人擔憂的長期下滑。Ohtani 的職業生涯歷史顯示他有能力在關鍵時刻回暖——但十月季後賽的時鐘正在倒數。

更大的背景不容忽視。隨著 Ohtani 不再投球，道奇隊的整體進攻定位發生根本轉變。他原本被定位為偶爾登板投球的指定打擊，能讓對手投手教練疲於應對的武器。如今他僅是指定打擊——而且是陷入低潮的指定打擊。Hernández、Freddie Freeman、Will Smith 等周邊打者構成的深厚打線足以吸收短期低潮，但若延續至季後賽則無法承受。

心理層面同樣值得關注。Ohtani 以低調自律著稱，但身為棒球史上最高薪球員、投球能力又已確定無法使用的壓力，創造出截然不同的心理負擔。道奇隊指望他成為球隊簽約時預期的進攻引擎，但此刻他正處於油箱見底的狀態。

segments.headline: Roster Reboot: Smith, Rushing Activate as Dodgers Build October Depth
segments.headline_zh: 陣容大換血：Smith、Rushing 解除傷兵名單，道奇隊為十月深度備戰
segments.analysis:
The Dodgers' September roster expansion has been anything but routine this year. Catcher Will Smith returned from a three-month IL stint (neck) on September 1, and prospect Dalton Rushing was activated from the 10-day IL. Pitcher Justin Wrobleski and infielder Alex Freeland were also added, while Ben Rortvedt was designated for assignment. It's a flurry of moves that reflects both the team's depth and the reality that health — not talent — has been the Dodgers' defining challenge in 2026.

Smith's return is the headline. The All-Star catcher has been one of the most valuable backstops in baseball when healthy, and his three-month absence left a void behind the plate that no one else could fully fill. His bat — typically a .270/.350/.480 slash line — adds a dimension to the middle of the order that the Dodgers have sorely missed. If he can stay healthy through October, he's a legitimate difference-maker in any playoff series.

Rushing's activation is more about the future. The top catching prospect in the organization was expected to contribute this year, and his return from injury gives the Dodgers a safety net behind Smith — and a potential postseason weapon if the coaching staff trusts him in high-leverage situations. Rushing's bat has always been ahead of his glove, but his ability to handle premium velocity makes him a useful piece in a pinch.

The roster churn underscores a broader theme: the 2026 Dodgers have been one of the most injured teams in recent memory. The fact that they're 87-57 despite a revolving door of IL stints speaks to the organization's depth, scouting acumen, and ability to develop contributors at every level. But it also raises a question: will this team be healthy enough in October to field its best possible roster?
segments.analysis_zh:
道奇隊今年的九月擴編名單絕非例行公事。捕手 Will Smith 在頸部傷勢缺陣三個月後於 9 月 1 日復出，新秀 Dalton Rushing 也從 10 天傷兵名單解除。投手 Justin Wrobleski 和內野手 Alex Freeland 同樣被加入，而 Ben Rortvedt 則被指定讓渡。這一系列操作既反映球隊的陣容深度，也凸顯 2026 年道奇隊面臨的核心挑戰是健康而非天賦。

Smith 的回歸是焦點。這位全明星捕手在健康時是聯盟最具價值的後方指揮官，三個月的缺陣在本壘板後方留下了難以完全填補的缺口。他的打擊——通常約 .270/.350/.480 的三圍數據——為中段打線增添了球隊迫切需要的維度。若能健康到十月，他將在任何季後賽系列賽中扮演關鍵角色。

Rushing 的復出則更關乎未來。這位組織內頂級捕手新秀原本被預期今年就能貢獻，他的回歸為 Smith 後方提供了保險——若教練團信任他在高壓局面中的表現，更可能成為季後賽的潛在武器。Rushing 的打擊能力一直優於他的防守手套，但他處理高轉速速球的能力使他在關鍵時刻成為可用之材。

頻繁的人員調度凸顯了一個更大的主題：2026 年的道奇隊是近年來受傷最嚴重的球隊之一。在如此頻繁的傷兵名單流動下仍保持 87 戰 57 敗的戰績，歸功於組織的深度、球探能力以及在各層級培養貢獻者的本領。但這也引出一個問題：十月的道奇隊能否湊齊最佳陣容？

segments.headline: Glasnow Returns to Form as Dodgers Rotation Nears Full Strength for October
segments.headline_zh: Glasnow 回歸正軌，道奇隊先發輪值趨近完整備戰十月
segments.analysis:
Tyler Glasnow's August 25 activation from the 60-day IL felt like a turning point. The 6'8" right-hander had missed over three months with lower back spasms — an injury that, for a pitcher of his build, always carried a ominous undertone. But his return outing against Atlanta looked sharp, and the underlying metrics suggest his stuff is as nasty as ever. In seven starts before the injury, Glasnow posted a 2.72 ERA with a 34.8% strikeout rate, numbers that ranked among the best in the National League.

What makes Glasnow's return so significant is the rotation he now slots into. Yamamoto, Skubal, Snell, Sasaki, and Glasnow give the Dodgers a potential five-man playoff rotation that could rival any in baseball history. Each brings a different look — Yamamoto's command, Skubal's power left-handed slider, Snell's swinging-strike ability, Sasaki's raw velocity, and Glasnow's devastating curveball. It's a murderer's row of arms that opposing lineups will struggle to game-plan against.

The timing is critical. Glasnow needed September to build his arm back up to full workload, and every start between now and the end of the regular season is essentially a tune-up for October. The Dodgers can afford to manage his innings carefully, giving him an extra day of rest here and there, because they have the depth to absorb it. It's luxury that most teams can only dream of — and a luxury the Dodgers will need if they're going to navigate the gauntlet of the NL bracket.

The knock on Glasnow has always been durability. He's never thrown more than 134 innings in a season, and his injury history is extensive. But the Dodgers' plan has always been to peak at the right time — to have Glasnow healthy and dominant when the calendar turns to October. If that plan works, it could be the defining factor in a championship run.
segments.analysis_zh:
Tyler Glasnow 於 8 月 25 日從 60 天傷兵名單復出，感覺是一個轉捩點。這位身高 6 呎 8 吋的右投手因下背痙攣缺陣超過三個月——以他的身材而言，這種傷勢總是帶有不祥的預兆。但他對勇士隊的復出登板表現銳利，底層數據也顯示他的球威不減。受傷前的七場先發中，Glasnow 繳出 2.72 的自責分率和 34.8% 的三振率，這些數據在國聯名列前茅。

Glasnow 回歸之所以如此重要，在於他現在所加入的投手輪值。Yamamoto、Skubal、Snell、Sasaki 加上 Glasnow，道奇隊有潛力組出一套可與棒球史上任何時期媲美的季後賽五人先發。每人帶來不同的風格——Yamamoto 的控球、Skubal 的強力左投滑球、Snell 的揮空能力、Sasaki 的原始球速，以及 Glasnow 毀滅性的曲球。這是一組令對手打線難以應對的致命武器。

時機至關重要。Glasnow 需要九月將手臂負荷逐步提升至完整工作量，從現在到例行賽結束的每一場先發都是為十月所做的調整。道奇隊可以謹慎管理他的投球局數，在需要時多給一天休息，因為球隊有足夠的深度來承受。這是大多數球隊只能夢想的奢侈——也是道奇隊若要征服國聯季後賽之路所必需的資本。

對 Glasnow 的質疑始終圍繞著耐久性。他從未單季投超過 134 局，且傷病史豐富。但道奇隊的計畫始終是在正確的時間達到巔峰——讓 Glasnow 在十月到來時健康且具統治力。若此計畫成功，這可能成為奪冠之路的決定性因素。

segments.headline: Maiava Wins Back-to-Back Big Ten Offensive Player of the Week After 92% Completion Day
segments.headline_zh: Maiava 以 92% 傳球成功率連續第二週獲選大聯盟進攻球員週最佳
segments.analysis:
Jayden Maiava is making a mockery of the Big Ten. The USC quarterback earned his second consecutive conference offensive player of the week honor after going 23-of-25 (92.0%) for 349 yards and three touchdowns in Friday's 39-0 demolition of Fresno State. It's not just the numbers — it's the efficiency. Maiava's 92.0% completion rate is the highest single-game mark by a USC quarterback since at least 1995, a quarter-century of signal-callers that includes Carson Palmer, Matt Leinart, and Sam Darnold.

Through two games, Maiava leads the nation with 635 passing yards. He's completing passes at a rate that makes college defenses look like they're standing still. The offensive line is giving him time, the receiving corps is getting open, and Maiava is making throws with a decisiveness that belies his experience level. This is not a system quarterback riding elite talent around him — this is a quarterback elevating the entire operation.

The USC coaching staff, under Lincoln Riley, has always been known for quarterback development, but Maiava is exceeding even the most optimistic projections. His pocket presence has improved dramatically from last season, and his ability to read defenses pre-snap has shortened the learning curve for a young quarterback operating in a complex system. If this continues, Maiava isn't just a Big Ten player of the week candidate — he's a Heisman contender.

The challenge ahead, however, is formidable. USC opens Big Ten play at Rutgers on September 19, then hosts No. 2 Oregon on September 26 before facing Penn State, Wisconsin, Ohio State, and Indiana in succession. The first two games were a warm-up; the next eight will be the real test. Can Maiava sustain this level of production against defenses designed to take away his first read?
segments.analysis_zh:
Jayden Maiava 正以驚人表現讓大聯盟各隊望塵莫及。這位南加大四分衛在週五 39-0 痛宰 Fresno State 的比賽中，以 25 次傳球成功 23 次（92.0% 成功率）的效率繳出 349 碼和 3 次達陣，連續第二週獲選大聯盟進攻球員週最佳。不只是數據亮眼——更在於效率。Maiava 92.0% 的單場傳球成功率，是自 1995 年以來南加大四分衛的最高紀錄，過去 25 年間包括 Carson Palmer、Matt Leinart 和 Sam Darnold 都未能達成。

經過兩場比賽，Maiava 以 635 碼領先全國。他的傳球成功率讓大學防守組看起來像是在原地踏步。進攻鋒線給予他充足的時間，接球群體持續跑出空檔，而 Maiava 以果斷的判斷做出傳球決定，展現出超越其經驗水準的成熟度。這不是依靠周圍精英人才的體系四分衛——而是一位提升整體進攻運作的四分衛。

Lincoln Riley 領導的南加大教練團向來以培養四分衛聞名，但 Maiava 的表現甚至超越了最樂觀的預期。他的口袋意識較上季有顯著進步，且在開賽前閱讀防守的能力縮短了年輕四分衛適應複雜體系的學習曲線。若能持續此表現，Maiava 不僅是大聯盟週最佳進攻球員的候選人——更是海斯曼獎的有力競爭者。

然而前方的挑戰極為嚴峻。南加大將於 9 月 19 日在客場對羅格斯大學開啓大聯盟賽程，9 月 26 日迎戰全美第二的俄勒岡大學，隨後連續面對賓州州立、威斯康辛、俄亥俄州立和印第安納。前兩場比賽只是熱身；接下來的八場才是真正的考驗。Maiava 能否在針對他的第一接球選擇設計防守的對手面前維持此水準？

segments.headline: Trojans Record First Shutout Since 2024 in 39-0 Rout of Fresno State
segments.headline_zh: 南加大隊自 2024 年以來首場完封，39-0 大勝 Fresno State
segments.analysis:
USC's 39-0 shutout of Fresno State on Friday night wasn't just a win — it was a statement. The Trojans' first shutout since a 48-0 blanking of Utah State in 2024, it was only the second shutout of the Lincoln Riley era and a reflection of a defense that has quietly become one of the most improved units in the Big Ten. The defense added two safeties, mixed in aggressive blitz packages, and held Fresno State to a season-low in total yards.

The numbers are staggering. Through two games, USC has outscored opponents 58-0 in the first half while outgaining them 1,057-452 in total offense. That's not a typo. The Trojans have not allowed a single first-half point while averaging 29 points per opening half themselves. New defensive coordinator Gary Patterson has installed a more aggressive, multiple-front scheme that has transformed the unit from a liability into a weapon.

Safety Kennedy Urlacher — son of Pro Football Hall of Famer Brian Urlacher — forced a fumble and blitzed for a safety, embodying the aggressive mindset Patterson has instilled. The secondary is playing with more confidence, the defensive line is generating pressure without needing to blitz, and the linebacker corps is filling gaps at a rate that has stuffed opposing run games. It's a complete defensive transformation in just two games.

Lincoln Riley is now 26-0 when his defense allows 15 points or fewer. That's a staggering record that speaks to USC's ability to close out games when the defense does its job. The concern, historically, has been whether this defense can sustain its performance against elite offenses — the kind they'll face in Big Ten play. Rutgers, Oregon, and Penn State won't be Fresno State.
segments.analysis_zh:
南加大隊週五晚間 39-0 完封 Fresno State 不僅是一場勝利——更是一項宣言。這是特洛伊人隊自 2024 年 48-0 橫掃猶他州立以來的首次完封，也是 Lincoln Riley 時代的第二場完封，反映了防守組悄然成為大聯盟進步幅度最大的單位之一。防守端完成兩次擒殺得分，混合激進的突襲戰術，並將 Fresno State 限制在賽季新低的總碼數。

數據令人震撼。經過兩場比賽，南加大在上半場以 58-0 領先對手，總進攻碼數以 1,057-452 取得壓倒性優勢。這不是打字錯誤。特洛伊人隊上半場未讓對手得到任何分數，而自己平均在上半場得到 29 分。新任防守協調員 Gary Patterson 安裝了更具侵略性、多變的防守前線，將這支部隊從弱點轉變為武器。

安全衛 Kennedy Urlacher——職業足球名人堂成員 Brian Urlacher 之子——製造了一次掉球並突襲完成擒殺得分，體現了 Patterson 所灌輸的侵略性思維。 secondary 的信心明顯提升，防守鋒線無需突襲就能製造壓力，線衛群在填補空檔的效率上讓對手的地面進攻陷入困境。這是僅兩場比賽內完成的全面防守轉型。

Lincoln Riley 在防守組允許 15 分或以下時的戰績來到 26 勝 0 敗。這是一項驚人的紀錄，凸顯了南加大在防守組完成任務時關門比賽的能力。然而歷史上的擔憂在於，這種防守表現能否在面對精英進攻時維持——而他們在大聯盟賽程中將面對的正是此類對手。羅格斯、俄勒岡和賓州州立不是 Fresno State。

segments.headline: Freshman Trent Mosley Emerges as USC's Most Dangerous Weapon
segments.headline_zh: 新秀 Trent Mosley 脫穎而出，成為南加大最具威脅的武器
segments.analysis:
The college football world is officially on notice about Trent Mosley. The freshman wide receiver torched Fresno State for two touchdowns, including a spectacular 68-yard scoring grab that showcased his speed, route-running, and ability to create separation at the line of scrimmage. ESPN's Adam Rittenberg called him 'a problem' — and in the context of a Big Ten schedule that features some of the nation's best secondaries, that's a designation no defensive coordinator wants to hear.

Mosley's emergence has been the most pleasant surprise of USC's early season. Expectations were high for the five-star recruit, but few predicted he'd be this impactful this quickly. His chemistry with Maiava is already electric, with the two connecting on multiple deep balls and intermediate routes with a precision that suggests extensive practice time together. In a receiving corps that includes established veterans, Mosley has quickly become the most dynamic threat.

From a schematic standpoint, Mosley gives USC something they've lacked in recent years: a true field-stretcher who can take the top off a defense. His presence opens up the underneath routes for other receivers and creates running lanes for the ground game. Defensive coordinators will now have to account for him on every snap, which frees up space for USC's other offensive weapons.

The question is sustainability. Freshman wide receivers historically hit a wall as the season progresses and opponents gain more film on their tendencies. Mosley will face tighter coverage, more bracket schemes, and physical press corners as Big Ten play begins. How he responds will determine whether USC's offense is truly elite or merely very good.
segments.analysis_zh:
大學足球界正式對 Trent Mosley 發出警報。這位新秀外接手在對 Fresno State 的比賽中攻下兩次達陣，其中包括一次精彩的 68 碼接球得分，展現了他的速度、路線跑法和在開球線上創造分離的能力。ESPN 的 Adam Rittenberg 形容他是「一個麻煩」——而在大聯盟賽程中擁有全國頂級 secondary 的背景下，這是任何防守協調員都不想聽到的評價。

Mosley 的崛起是南加大本賽季初期最令人驚喜的收穫。這位五星級新秀被寄予厚望，但很少有人預期他能如此快速地產生影響力。他與 Maiava 之間的化學反應已經相當火熱，兩人多次在深傳和中距離路線上精準連線，展現出大量共同練習的默契。在一個擁有資深老將的接球群中，Mosley 迅速成為最具爆發力的威脅。

從戰術層面而言，Mosley 給了南加大近年來所缺乏的元素：一位真正的纵向拉長防守的外接手。他的存在為其他接球手開啟了底線路線，並為地面進攻創造跑動空間。防守協調員現在必須在每一次 snap 時對他進行布防，這為南加大的其他進攻武器騰出了空間。

問題在於可持續性。新秀外接手在賽季推進中經常撞牆，因為對手逐漸掌握其習慣模式。Mosley 在大聯盟賽程開始後將面對更緊密的盯防、更多夾擊方案和更具侵略性的 press corner。他如何回應將決定南加大的進攻究竟是精英級還是僅止於優秀。

segments.headline: USC Hosts Louisiana in Final Nonconference Test Before Big Ten Gauntlet
segments.headline_zh: 南加大迎戰 Louisiana，非聯盟賽程最後一戰後迎戰大聯盟嚴酷考驗
segments.analysis:
USC will close out its three-game homestand Saturday at 8 p.m. PT when it hosts Louisiana at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum. The two programs have never met, and Louisiana — under head coach Michael Desormeaux — enters at 1-0 after a season-opening win. It's the final tune-up before Big Ten play begins in earnest, and the Trojans are heavily favored to move to 3-0.

For the coaching staff, Saturday's game is about health and execution, not style points. Lincoln Riley will want to see his starters play efficiently in the first half and then yield to backups by the third quarter. The focus will be on maintaining rhythm — particularly for Maiava and the offense — without exposing key players to unnecessary injury risk. A clean, controlled victory would be the ideal outcome.

The bigger picture is what follows. USC opens Big Ten play at Rutgers on September 19, then hosts No. 2 Oregon on September 26. That Oregon game, in particular, looms as the defining moment of the early season. The Ducks, loaded with NFL talent and operating a high-powered offense, represent the first true test of whether USC's dominant early performance translates against elite competition. Penn State, Wisconsin, and Ohio State follow in quick succession.

There's also a recruiting angle to Saturday's game. USC's 2027 class is taking shape, with several top prospects expected to attend the Coliseum. Five-star athlete Honor Fa'alave-Johnson headlines the group, and a dominant performance by the Trojans could help solidify commitments from wavering recruits. In the modern era of college football, recruiting weekends are carefully choreographed — and Saturday's game is a showcase.
segments.analysis_zh:
南加大將於週六晚間 8 時（太平洋時間）在洛杉磯紀念體育場迎戰 Louisiana，為三場主場系列賽畫下句點。兩校從未交手，Louisiana 在總教練 Michael Desormeaux 帶領下以 1 戰 0 敗的戰績開季。這是大聯盟賽程正式開始前的最後調整，特洛伊人隊被看好能將戰績推進至 3 勝 0 敗。

對教練團而言，週六的比賽關乎健康與執行力，而非勝差。Lincoln Riley 希望看到先發球員在上半場有效率地比賽，然後在第三節交棒給替補。重點是維持節奏——特別是 Maiava 和進攻組——同時避免關鍵球員承受不必要的受傷風險。一場乾淨、可控的勝利將是理想結果。

更大的局勢在於後方的賽程。南加大將於 9 月 19 日在客場對羅格斯大學開啓大聯盟賽程，9 月 26 日迎戰全美第二的俄勒岡大學。其中與俄勒岡的比賽被視為本賽季初期的決定性時刻。擁有大量 NFL 人才和高效進攻的俄勒岡隊，是南加大早期統治力能否延續至精英對抗的首個真正考驗。賓州州立、威斯康辛和俄亥俄州立緊接而至。

週六的比賽還有招募層面的意義。南加大 2027 屆的招募班級正在成形，多位頂級新秀預計將到場觀戰。五星級運動員 Honor Fa'alave-Johnson 是班級的領頭人物，特洛伊人隊的強勢表現可能幫助鞏固猶豫不決新秀的承諾。在現代大學足球中，招募週末是精心策劃的——而週六的比賽正是一場展示。

segments.headline: Rams vs. 49ers in Melbourne: NFL Makes History With First-Ever Game in Australia
segments.headline_zh: 公羊隊對 49 人隊將在墨爾本上演：NFL 史上首次在澳洲舉行的正式比賽
segments.analysis:
The Los Angeles Rams will kick off the 2026 NFL season in the most improbable setting imaginable: the Melbourne Cricket Ground, in front of a capacity crowd of 100,000 Australians experiencing their first-ever regular-season NFL game. The 5:35 p.m. PT Thursday kickoff — simulcast on Netflix and traditional broadcast partners — marks a watershed moment for the league's international expansion strategy. The Rams are 3.5-point favorites against their NFC West rivals, but the X-factor of a 17-hour time difference, jet lag, and an unfamiliar surface looms over everything.

Sean McVay has approached the Melbourne trip with characteristic preparation. The team arrived early in the week to acclimate, held light practices at local facilities, and emphasized the mental reset needed to perform in an alien environment. McVay has been transparent that the goal is to play clean football — limit turnovers, avoid penalties, and let talent win out over logistics. It's a pragmatism born from experience: the NFL's international games have historically produced sloppy, high-turnover affairs.

The matchup itself is tantalizing. The 49ers, still smarting from last year's playoff exit, have retooled around Brock Purdy and a revamped defense. San Francisco's front seven remains one of the most fearsome in football, and their ability to pressure Stafford could be the deciding factor. But the Rams counter with arguably the deepest offensive skill-position group in the league — Stafford, Nacua, Adams, and now Tutu Atwell returning to add speed to an already loaded receiving corps.

For the NFL, this game is about more than football. It's a $300 million bet that the Australian market can sustain year-round engagement with the sport. The league has committed to multiple games in Australia over the coming years, and the success of this opener — measured in television ratings, merchandise sales, and cultural penetration — will determine the pace of that expansion. The Rams aren't just playing for a Week 1 win; they're playing for the future of the NFL's footprint in the Southern Hemisphere.
segments.analysis_zh:
洛杉磯公羊隊將在最令人難以置信的場地揭開 2026 年 NFL 賽季序幕：墨爾本板球場，容納 10 萬名首次親歷 NFL 正式比賽的澳洲觀眾。太平洋時間週四下午 5:35 的開球——由 Netflix 和傳統轉播合作夥伴同步播出——標誌著聯盟國際擴張策略的里程碑。公羊隊對陣國聯西區宿敵，目前被看好讓 3.5 分，但 17 小時的時差、時差反應和不熟悉的場地等因素構成了不可忽視的變數。

Sean McVay 以其典型的周密方式處理墨爾本之旅。球隊提前一週抵達以適應環境，在當地設施進行輕量練習，並強調在陌生環境中比賽所需的思維重置。McVay 坦率表示目標是打出乾淨的比賽——減少失誤、避免犯規，讓天賦戰勝後勤挑戰。這是源於經驗的務實態度：NFL 的國際賽事歷來容易產生混亂、高失誤的比賽。

對戰本身令人期待。49 人隊仍在為去年季後賽的出局感到刺痛，已圍繞 Brock Purdy 和重組的防守組進行調整。舊金山的前鋒七人組仍是聯盟最具威脅性的防線之一，他們壓迫 Stafford 的能力可能是決定性因素。但公羊隊的反擊武器堪稱聯盟最深厚的進攻技能球員群——Stafford、Nacua、Adams，加上 Tutu Atwell 回歸為已經豪華的接球群增添速度。

對 NFL 而言，這場比賽超越了足球本身。這是對澳洲市場能否全年維持與運動 Engagement 的 3 億美元豪賭。聯盟已承諾未來數年在澳洲舉辦多場比賽，而這場開幕戰的成功——以電視收視率、商品銷售和文化滲透率衡量——將決定擴張的步伐。公羊隊不只是在爭取第一週的勝利；他們在為 NFL 在南半球的版圖未來而戰。

segments.headline: Myles Garrett Returns to Practice After Knee Scare; Status for Week 1 Improving
segments.headline_zh: Myles Garrett 膝傷虛驚後重返練習，第一週出賽狀態好轉
segments.analysis:
The reigning Defensive Player of the Year is back on the field. Myles Garrett returned to practice September 6 after missing several weeks with knee swelling, and Sean McVay told reporters that Garrett is 'making really good progress' toward being ready for Thursday's Melbourne opener. The 30-year-old edge rusher — who set the single-season sack record with 23 in 2025 — was seen going through individual drills with no apparent limitation, a reassuring sight for a Rams defense that depends on his presence.

Garrett's knee issue had been the elephant in the room throughout training camp. The Rams acquired him in a blockbuster trade knowing that his durability was a question mark — he'd missed time in previous seasons — but the payoff was too significant to ignore. A 23-sack season earns you the benefit of the doubt, and the Rams have managed his workload carefully to ensure he's fresh for the games that matter. Whether he plays Thursday remains uncertain, but the trajectory is clearly positive.

The impact of Garrett on this defense cannot be overstated. With Aaron Donald coming out of retirement to rejoin the interior line, and Garrett providing edge pressure, the Rams suddenly have a pass rush that can change games. The two have practiced together sparingly but have already developed a chemistry based on mutual respect and shared intensity. If both are healthy for the postseason, the Rams' defense could be the best in football.

For Week 1, the smart money is on Garrett being available in some capacity — perhaps on a snap count, but available. The Rams can't afford to risk long-term health for a September game, even one as historic as Melbourne. But the mere fact that Garrett is back practicing suggests the knee is not a chronic concern. It's a situation to monitor, but the early returns are encouraging.
segments.analysis_zh:
年度最佳防守球員重返球場。Myles Garrett 於 9 月 6 日重返練習，此前因膝蓋積水缺席數週，Sean McVay 告訴記者 Garrett 在準備墨爾本開幕戰方面「進展非常好」。這位 30 歲的邊鋒衝鋒手——2025 年以 23 次擒殺創下單季紀錄——被看到進行無明顯限制的個人訓練，對依賴其存在的公羊防守組而言是令人安心的景象。

Garrett 的膝蓋問題一直是訓練營期間房間裡的大象。公羊隊在引發重大交易時就知道他的耐用性存疑——他過去數季曾缺陣——但回報太過顯著而無法忽視。23 次擒殺的賽季為你贏得了信任票，球隊一直謹慎管理他的工作量，確保他在關鍵比賽中保持新鮮。他週四是否出賽仍不確定，但發展趨勢明顯正面。

Garrett 對這支防守組的影響怎麼強調都不為過。隨著 Aaron Donald 從退休中復出重返內側鋒線，Garrett 提供邊緣壓力，公羊隊突然擁有能改變比賽的傳球衝鋒。兩人僅一起訓練過少數次，但已基於相互尊重和共同的侵略性建立起默契。若兩人能在季後賽保持健康，公羊的防守可能是聯盟最佳。

就第一週而言，聰明的賭注是 Garrett 將以某種形式出場——可能在 snap 限制下，但確定可用。公羊隊無法為了九月的比賽犧牲長期健康，即使這場比賽如墨爾本般具有歷史意義。但 Garrett 已重返練習本身即暗示膝蓋並非慢性問題。這是需要持續關注的情況，但早期回報令人鼓舞。

segments.headline: Stafford and Adams Building Elite Chemistry as Rams Prepare for 2026 Offensive Explosion
segments.headline_zh: Stafford 與 Adams 建立頂級默契，公羊隊備戰 2026 年進攻大爆發
segments.analysis:
The marriage of Matthew Stafford and Davante Adams is already looking like the best free-agent signing of 2026. The two connected repeatedly throughout training camp, building on the rapport they developed during the second half of last season. Adams, signed in March after the Cooper Kupp release, gives Stafford a route-running savant on the outside — a receiver who can win at all three levels of the field and create separation against any coverage.

The numbers from 2025 tell the story: Stafford led the NFL with 4,707 passing yards and 46 touchdowns, winning his first MVP at age 37. He did it largely without a true No. 2 receiver opposite Puka Nacua. Now he has Adams — a player who's been to five Pro Bowls and has consistently produced 1,000-yard seasons — to draw coverage away from Nacua and give Stafford an elite option on every dropback. The possibilities are staggering.

From a schematic perspective, defensive coordinators face an impossible dilemma. Bracket Nacua, and Adams will eat you alive on one-on-ones. Double Adams, and Nacua's 129-catch production from last season will only increase. Add Tutu Atwell's speed to the mix, and the Rams suddenly have a three-headed monster at receiver that can attack every zone in the field. Sean McVay's play-designing genius will have more toys to work with than ever before.

The Rams went 3-0 in the preseason, beating the Chiefs, Saints, and Chargers. The offense looked fluid, Stafford looked sharp, and the chemistry between quarterback and receivers was evident even in limited preseason action. If the Rams can keep Stafford clean in the pocket — a big if, given the offensive line's inconsistency — this could be the highest-scoring offense in the NFL.
segments.analysis_zh:
Matthew Stafford 與 Davante Adams 的結合已經看起來像 2026 年最佳自由球員簽約。兩人整個訓練營期間不斷完成連線，延續了上季後半段建立的默契。Adams 於三月在 Cooper Kupp 被釋出後加盟，為 Stafford 在外側提供了一位路線跑法的專家——一位能在球場三個層級取勝、對任何防守都能創造分離的外接手。

2025 年的數據說明一切：Stafford 以 4,707 碼和 46 次達陣領先 NFL，37 歲時首次贏得 MVP。他 largely 在沒有真正二號接球手與 Puka Nacua 搭檔的情況下完成此壯舉。如今他擁有 Adams——一位五次入選職業盃、 consistently 產出千碼賽季的球員——來吸引防守注意力遠離 Nacua，並在每次 dropback 時為 Stafford 提供精英級選擇。可能性令人震撼。

從戰術層面而言，防守協調員面臨不可能的兩難。夾擊 Nacua，Adams 將在一对一對決中吞噬你。雙人盯防 Adams，Nacua 去年 129 次接球的產量只會增加。再加入 Tutu Atwell 的速度，公羊隊突然擁有了一個能在球場任何區域發動攻擊的三頭怪獸。Sean McVay 的戰術設計天賦將擁有前所未有的武器。

公羊隊在季前賽中以 3 戰全勝擊敗酋長、聖徒和閃電。進攻組看起來流暢，Stafford 看起來銳利，四分衛與接球手之間的默契即使在有限的季前賽中也很明顯。若公羊隊能保護 Stafford 在口袋內的安全——鑑於進攻鋒線的不穩定，這是個大前提——這可能是 NFL 得分最高的進攻。

segments.headline: Aaron Donald Comes Out of Retirement to Rejoin Rams — Can He Still Dominate?
segments.headline_zh: Aaron Donald 從退休中復出重返公羊隊——他還能主宰比賽嗎？
segments.analysis:
Aaron Donald is back. After retiring following the 2023 Super Bowl victory, the greatest interior defensive lineman of his generation has returned to the Rams for the 2026 season. Donald said in his return press conference that he feels he can 'play at a high level,' and early practice reports suggest his power and quickness remain intact. For a player who dominated the trenches for a decade, the question isn't whether he can still play — it's whether he can sustain it for a full season.

The timing of Donald's return is no coincidence. The Rams made a calculated decision to pursue Myles Garrett in a blockbuster trade, and when Donald saw the defensive line forming around him, the competitive fire reignited. He'd been working out privately throughout his retirement, maintaining the physique and conditioning that made him a three-time Defensive Player of the Year. The desire to compete — to prove he can still be the best — clearly never left.

What Donald brings to this defense is both tangible and intangible. On the field, he commands double teams on every snap, freeing up linebackers and edge rushers to operate in space. His ability to collapse the pocket from the interior is something no other player in the league can replicate. Off the field, his presence elevates the entire defensive room. Young players feed off his intensity, his preparation, and his refusal to accept anything less than excellence.

The pairing of Donald and Garrett is the most fearsome defensive combination in football. When both are on the field, opposing offensive lines face a pick-your-poison scenario: double Donald and let Garrett rush one-on-one, or vice versa. Either way, someone is getting a free run at the quarterback. It's the kind of chess problem that offensive coordinators lose sleep over — and it's a problem the Rams have the luxury of deploying on every single snap.
segments.analysis_zh:
Aaron Donald 回來了。這位在 2023 年超級碗勝利後退休的世代最偉大內側防守鋒線球員，已重返公羊隊參加 2026 年賽季。Donald 在復出記者會上表示他感覺自己能「在高水準比賽」，早期的練習報告也顯示他的力量和敏捷性依然完好。對這位在戰壕中主宰了十年的球員而言，問題不是他是否還能打球——而是他能否維持一整季。

Donald 復出的時機絕非偶然。公羊隊經過深思熟慮後進行了 Myles Garrett 的重大交易，當 Donald 看到即將成形的防守鋒線時，競爭的火焰再次被點燃。他在退休期間持續私人訓練，維持著讓他成為三次年度最佳防守球員的體格和體能狀態。對競爭的渴望——證明自己仍是最佳——顯然從未離開。

Donald 給這支防守組帶來的既有有形價值也有無形價值。在場上，他在每一次 snap 時都吸引雙人盯防，釋放線衛和邊鋒衝鋒手在空間中操作。他從內側壓縮口袋的能力是聯盟中其他球員無法複製的。在場下，他的存在提升了整個防守組的氛圍。年輕球員從他的侵略性、他的準備工作和他拒絕接受任何低於卓越的態度中汲取能量。

Donald 和 Garrett 的組合是 football 中最令人畏懼的防守搭配。當兩人在場上時，對手進攻鋒線面臨一個選擇你的毒藥的情境：雙人盯防 Donald 讓 Garrett 一對一衝鋒，或反之。無論如何，總有人能自由衝向四分衛。這是讓進攻協調員夜不能寐的戰術難題——而公羊隊有幸在每一次 snap 時部署此問題。

segments.headline: Three Rams Land in NFL Top 10: Garrett No. 1, Stafford No. 4, Nacua No. 6
segments.headline_zh: 三名公羊球員跻身 NFL 前十：Garrett 第一、Stafford 第四、Nacua 第六
segments.analysis:
The Los Angeles Rams are the only team in the NFL with three players in the 2026 Top 100. Myles Garrett earned the No. 1 overall spot after his record-breaking 23-sack campaign in 2025. Matthew Stafford came in at No. 4 following his MVP season with 4,707 yards and 46 touchdowns. Puka Nacua rounded out the trio at No. 6 after leading the league with 129 receptions. It's a testament to the Rams' talent acquisition that three of the league's six best players wear the same uniform.

The Top 100 list is voted on by NFL players — the people who line up across from these men every Sunday. For Garrett to be voted No. 1 by his peers speaks to the respect he commands as a disruptive force. His 23 sacks didn't just break Michael Strahan's 22-year-old record; they terrorized offensive coordinators into fundamentally changing their game plans. When one player forces you to redesign your entire scheme, you know you're dealing with someone special.

Stafford's ranking is a vindication of the Rams' decision to trade for him in 2022. At 38 years old, he's showing no signs of decline. His arm strength remains elite, his decision-making has improved dramatically under McVay's tutelage, and his chemistry with his receivers is as good as any quarterback-receiver combination in the league. The fact that he's still ascending at an age when most quarterbacks are declining is remarkable.

Nacua's emergence as a top-six player is perhaps the most impressive of the three. A fifth-round pick in 2024, he's gone from afterthought to All-Pro in two seasons. His 129 catches led the league, but it's his consistency — never disappearing for more than a game — that sets him apart. Combined with Adams, the Rams now have two receivers who demand coverage, creating a luxury that Stafford will exploit ruthlessly.
segments.analysis_zh:
洛杉磯公羊隊是 NFL 中唯一擁有三名球員躋身 2026 年 Top 100 的球隊。Myles Garrett 憑藉 2025 年創紀錄的 23 次擒殺贏得第一順位。Matthew Stafford 在 MVP 賽季繳出 4,707 碼和 46 次達陣後排名第四。Puka Nacua 以聯盟領先的 129 次接球位列第六。這見證了公羊隊在人才取得上的成功——聯盟六位最佳球員中的三位身著同一隊服。

Top 100 名單由 NFL 球員投票選出——那些每週日與這些球員對位的人。Garrett 獲得同儕投票第一名，反映了他作為破壞性力量所贏得的尊重。他的 23 次擒殺不僅打破了 Michael Strahan 保持 22 年的紀錄；更讓進攻協調員因恐懼而根本改變比賽計畫。當一位球員迫使你重新設計整套體系時，你就知道面對的是特殊的存在。

Stafford 的排名是公羊隊 2022 年交易得到他的決策的平反。38 歲的他展現不出任何衰退跡象。他的臂力依然精英級，決策能力在 McVay 的指導下顯著提升，與接球手的默契堪稱聯盟最佳四分衛-接球手組合之一。在大多數四分衛走下坡的年齡仍持續進步，令人印象深刻。

Nacua 成為前六名球員是三人中最令人印象深刻的。2024 年第五輪選秀的他，兩年內從默默無聞成長為 All-Pro。他的 129 次接球領先聯盟，但真正區別他的是穩定性——從未連續兩場比賽消失。加上 Adams，公羊隊如今擁有兩位要求防守關注的外接手，創造了 Stafford 將無情利用的奢侈。

segments.headline: Tutu Atwell Returns: Speed Merchant Adds Another Weapon to Rams' Arsenal
segments.headline_zh: Tutu Atwell 回歸：速度專家為公羊隊武器庫再添利器
segments.analysis:
The Rams' receiving corps just got deeper. Tutu Atwell — the speedster who's been a fan favorite since his arrival in Los Angeles — is back for the 2026 season, declaring himself 'happy, excited and ready to get to work.' Atwell adds a vertical dimension that the Rams have occasionally lacked, and his return gives Sean McVay another chess piece to deploy in an already complex offensive scheme.

Atwell's value isn't in volume stats — he's never going to catch 80 passes. His value is in what he does to defenses when he's on the field. His 4.32 speed forces defensive coordinators to respect the deep ball, which opens up intermediate routes for Nacua and Adams. When Atwell runs a go route, the safety has to account for him, leaving the middle of the field vulnerable to Nacua's crossing patterns. It's a pick-your-poison scenario that no defensive coordinator wants to navigate.

The question with Atwell has always been consistency. He's shown flashes of brilliance — a 70-yard touchdown here, a clutch third-down conversion there — but has struggled to sustain production over a full season. If McVay can find a way to get Atwell 4-5 targets per game in favorable matchups, the Rams' offense becomes nearly impossible to defend. Atwell doesn't need to be a star; he just needs to be a credible deep threat.

With the Rams going 3-0 in the preseason and the offense already clicking, Atwell's return is the cherry on top. The weapons are there: Stafford at quarterback, Nacua and Adams at receiver, Tutu stretching the field, and a running game that can keep defenses honest. If the offensive line holds up — and that remains the biggest if — this Rams offense could be historically prolific.
segments.analysis_zh:
公羊隊的接球群陣容更加深厚了。Tutu Atwell——自抵達洛杉磯以來深受球迷喜愛的速度型外接手——回歸 2026 年賽季，宣稱自己「開心、興奮，已準備好投入工作」。Atwell 為公羊隊增添了纵深維度，他的回歸為 Sean McVay 在已經複雜的進攻體系中提供了另一枚戰術棋子。

Atwell 的價值不在於數據量——他從來不會接 80 次球。他的價值在於他在場上時對防守的影響。他 4.32 秒的 40 碼衝刺速度迫使防守協調員必須顧忌深傳，這為 Nacua 和 Adams 開啟了中距離路線。當 Atwell 跑纵深路線時，安全衛必須顧及他，讓中場 vulnerability 於 Nacua 的交叉路線。這是任何防守協調員都不想面對的選擇困境。

對 Atwell 的疑問始終圍繞著穩定性。他曾展現閃光——70 码達陣、關鍵的三檔轉換——但難以在整季維持產量。若 McVay 能找到方法在有利 matchup 中每場給 Atwell 4-5 次目標，公羊的進攻將幾乎無法防守。Atwell 不需要成為明星；他只需要是一個可信的纵深威脅。

公羊隊季前賽 3 戰全勝、進攻已經運作順暢，Atwell 的回歸是錦上添花。武器已經就位：Stafford 擔任四分衛，Nacua 和 Adams 擔任外接手，Tutu 拉長戰線，加上能讓防守保持誠實的地面進攻。若進攻鋒線能撐住——這仍是最大的前提——這支公羊進攻可能是歷史性的高效。

closing: From Melbourne to the Coliseum, from Ohtani's bat to Maiava's arm, it's a week that will define Los Angeles sports. The Rams kick off history on Thursday, USC looks to stay perfect on Saturday, and the Dodgers continue their October march through September. Stay hydrated, stay loud, and enjoy the ride.
closing_zh: 從墨爾本到紀念體育場，從 Ohtani 的球棒到 Maiava 的手臂，這一週將定義洛杉磯體壇的走向。公羊隊週四揭開歷史篇章，南加大週六尋求全勝延續，道奇隊繼續在九月向十月季後賽邁進。保持水分、保持熱情，享受這趟旅程。
